params.name: tradingDate
params.description: The trading day of the Bid/Offer

params.name: duid
params.description: The Unit or MNSP interconnectorId. A successful MNSP getBid response returns Link IDs in the DUID objects, not Interconnector IDs

params.name: service
params.description: The Bid/Offer service type, one of, ENERGY, MNSP, RAISE1SEC, RAISE6SEC, RAISE60SEC, RAISE5MIN, RAISEREG, LOWER6SEC, LOWER1SEC, LOWER60SEC, LOWER5MIN, LOWERREG

items.docs:
Returns an Energy, FCAS, or MNSP bid. It provides details for a specific Bid/Offer, including the interval, day, and submission information. If the parameters match, the specific Bid/Offer details return, otherwise an error displays.

This endpoint only has query parameters.

params.name: fromTradingDate
params.description: From Trading Day (inclusive), default is current trading day. Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339)

params.name: toTradingDate
params.description: Default is fromTradingDate + 7 days. A seven day range is returned. If you need a greater range, submit the getBids endpoint multiple times. For the selected date range when there is no explicit Bid/Offer, the last valid Bid/Offer displays. Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339)

params.name: service
params.description: The Bid/Offer service type, one of, ENERGY, MNSP, RAISE1SEC, RAISE6SEC, RAISE60SEC, RAISE5MIN, RAISEREG, LOWER1SEC, LOWER6SEC, LOWER60SEC, LOWER5MIN, LOWERREG

params.name: includeSuperseded
params.description: Specifies offers have to be retrieved. FALSE returns current effective bids, TRUE return all versions of bids/offers

params.name: duid
params.description: Dispatchable Unit identifier recorded in AEMO's systems. Must be upper case, maxLength: 10

items.docs:
Returns one or more Energy, FCAS, or MNSP Bid/Offers (not including interval data).
Use the following optional query parameters to search for a specific bid or offer: - fromTradingDate - toTradingDate - duid or interconnectorId
- service - includeSuperseded

params.name: referenceId
params.description: The bid submission's reference identifier. You must provide at least one query parameter in an API call

params.name: transactionId
params.description: The bid submission's transaction identifier. You must provide at least one query parameter in an API call

items.docs:
Retrieves a previous submission where the requesting participantId is the submitting participantId.
Provide at least one of the following query parameters, otherwise no results return:
- transactionId - referenceId
This endpoint only has query parameters.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: Identifier for a specific bid or offer submission

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of accepted submissions where the requesting participantId is the submitting participantId. Use the following optional query parameters to search for specific submissions:
- fromTradingDate - toTradingDate - transactionId - fromOfferTimeStamp - toOfferTimeStamp - referenceId - comments
This endpoint has query parameters only (no payload parameters).

Submit one or more Energy, FCAS, or MNSP Bids. It supports:
- Bids and Offers for multiple Trading Days, DUIDs (Dispatchable Unit or MSNP Interconnector ID), and FCAS Service Type. - Provision of Energy, FCAS, and MNSP bids/offers in the same submission. - Separate formats for Energy, FCAS, or MNSP bids/offers so you don't need to include unrequired fields.
You provide the Bid/Offer details in the energyBids, fcasBids, or mnspBids arrays in the JSON schema.
This endpoint has paylo
